ticket.summary: Create System API to pull Salesforce contact details
ticket.description:
Build a MuleSoft system API for retrieving Salesforce Service Cloud contact details.

## Operations
- GET /contact - Retrieve a contact by contactId

## Success Criteria
- Generate a RAML-first Mule app for contact retrieval
- Keep local mock mode enabled by default
- Suggest which existing Mule asset could be extended later

securityModel.description: Preserve the current JWT/OAuth exchange used for Salesforce access.

successCriteria: Existing Mule APIs are scanned read-only for extension guidance
